added_lines: family of parishes newsletter our lady crowned church st joseph’s church & holy family church gospel reflection: be persistent… and patient… our gospel today is about persistence… just as the widow in the story pesters the judge until he delivers a just decision we too are called to be persistent. persistence in prayer demonstrates that we are not afraid to show our dependence on god even though all around us society says we need be self-sufficient, to look after ourselves. to keep praying is equally looking after ourselves but also the needs of those around us and the needs of our world. the widow in the story is concerned about the delay in getting a response, however we must not only must persevere in prayer we must be patient, awaiting god’s time for an answer and accepting the answer even though it may not be one we wanted! god will always give the right answer to our prayers, even if in the immediate moment it may not seem that way. take time to reflect on what have been the fruits of your own persistent prayer? when you have patiently waited for god’s time and response… parish clergy contact details moderator & co-pp: fr charles kiely our lady crowned church, upper mayfield, cork. telephone:
